founder.description: Understand my founding team, make agreements, find co-founders – alone or in a team.

onboarding.planChangeable: Nothing is final: as a founder or advisor you can change this any time in your profile.

align.name: Align
align.text: Here you work out how you work and decide – and how well that fits with someone else. Not a personality test, but a basis for honest conversations.
align.textAdvisor: Here you see what the people you support have shared with you — their answers and where they differ. You do not fill anything in here yourself.

find.name: Find
find.text: Here you look for people you could found with. You say what you're looking for and what you bring – and see who matches that.

connect.name: Connect
connect.text: Here you meet the network: people with what they offer and need, real problems from other people's days – and everything business ideas grow out of.

onboarding.areasLater: You can add the other areas whenever you like – in your profile, with one checkbox.
onboarding.planChangeableConnect: And if you decide to found something later, we'll open up Align and Find – just drop us a line.
onboarding.areasLaterConnect: Align and Find are open to you whenever you want – just get in touch and we'll unlock them.
onboarding.nonDiagnosticHintAdvisor: Made2Found is not a personality test. It helps the teams you support make their collaboration clearer and more robust, early on.

welcomePoints.areas: Three areas you use on their own: Align, Find and Connect. You don't need one for another.
welcomePoints.consent: You decide who sees what. Every release is separate and can be withdrawn at any time.
welcomePoints.noScore: Nothing is scored: no score, no match percentage, no types.

welcomeLetter.returningIntro: Before you carry on, a few words from me and how we treat each other here. You will only see this once.
welcomeLetter.story1: Founding is a roller coaster – and sometimes it derails. That is exactly what happened to me in 2025: after years as a sole entrepreneur and in a classic job, I joined a startup and fell flat on my face. Mostly because the dynamics and the communication between me and my co-founder were off. The crisis afterwards was worse than bad.
welcomeLetter.story2: Made2Found came out of exactly that time. I became a mother at 17, I know detours, and I firmly believe: there is not one right way to found.
welcomeLetter.story3: Success depends on so many individual factors and life realities. But teams almost never fail because of a lack of will or a bad idea – they fail because of things left unsaid.
welcomeLetter.story4: If we talk early about the right things, clarify expectations and treat each other honestly, working together holds. Then conflicts do not surface only when it is already too late and people slide into a crisis. That is what I want to prevent.
welcomeLetter.story5: See Made2Found as your protected space: take what you need, get answers to the delicate questions and build partnerships that withstand real storms.
welcomeLetter.story6: And if you like, write to me directly at any time. I am around here myself every day.
